name: Agility Medical Group LLC
old_description: From your brain to your joints, moving every day has the power to improve every part of your body. But when pain and injury get in the way of your goals, we provide you with the best equipment in the industry to get you Back in the Game of Life™ faster.
about:
Agility Medical Group LLC operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, serving as a distributor of orthopedic rehabilitation equipment. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it has established a regional presence with representatives across Oklahoma and Kansas.

The firm procures and supplies non-operative, post-surgical, and preventative maintenance products from manufacturers such as DonJoy, Aircast, and Kinex Medical Company. Its offerings include continuous passive motion (CPM) machines and a range of bracing and therapy devices. Agility Medical Group coordinates product delivery and provides return logistics for prescribed equipment, operating from an office at 3112 Cooke Way in Oklahoma City.

The customer base includes medical professionals, physicians, and individual patients seeking recovery solutions. The company focuses on the orthopedic rehabilitation segment of the healthcare market, emphasizing access to advanced, high-quality products for non-operative and post-surgical care.

Agility Medical Group states that its mission centers on delivering premium products and outstanding service while fostering a positive work environment through initiatives like Character Core and the Great Game of Business model. The leadership highlights a team-driven culture and community involvement as core to its approach.
